change.implementation: scripts/backup.mjs requires every job to resolve to a real project, a session owned by that project, and a node owned by the same project and session
change.boundary: backup creation and restore reject dangling or cross-scope job ownership before atomic promotion
change.negativeFixture: a synthetic credential-free job whose nodeId points to a nonexistent database entity

limitations: This increment validates job-to-project/session/node ownership but does not yet validate every relationship among all database entity kinds.
Independent review, off-host retention, staging drills and production rollback remain separately gated.
